title: Gallaudet sees the Go Fast video on the Navy Secret Network
place_text: Off the US East Coast (USS Theodore Roosevelt exercise); Navy Secret Network

tellings.quote: I was a onestar admiral and I saw on the Navy Secret Network the Go Fast video.

plain: In 2015, the Go Fast video, footage from Navy jets of a small object racing low over the ocean during an exercise with the carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt off the US East Coast, was passed around inside the Navy on its classified computer network. A retired Navy admiral named Tim Gallaudet tells Michels he saw it there himself: "I was a onestar admiral and I saw on the Navy Secret Network the Go Fast video," and he links it to the reports of Ryan Graves, a Navy fighter pilot. If true, it means senior Navy officers were watching the footage through official channels when it was recorded.
